v18.5.0 release test sweep, **round 2** on the release sha, wave anchor #33761. Slice **R2-BR**: the 33 browser/mixed items of `touched:a557fa386bc3` (80 touched minus the 2 `priority:P0` overlaps = 78; the other 45 are the api/cli/build slice R2-API, a separate record, so they read NOT-RUN here). Dispatched by qa#3 (seat #33014). Round 1 for these items: #33853 (slice BR1) and the R-185-BR2 record. Labels: `qa-run` only.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: objectstack-ai/objectstack `b914e7247f69` = the Version Packages merge (#33097, 2026-11-15 12:01Z), 26 first-parent commits past round 1's `a557fa38`. `GET /api/v1/health` → `version: "18.5.0"`, `GET /api/v1/discovery` → `version: "18.5.0"`, `objectstack --version` → `@objectstack/cli/18.5.0 linux-x64 node-v22.23.4`, on every boot. Console under `/_console` built in the same tree from `ui/`.
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (20 s); `pnpm build --concurrency=2` with `OS_SKIP_DTS` unset, 119 tasks, 12m49s; `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` (cache hit + copy); `check-dev-prereqs` 107/107.
- App: `examples/app-showcase`, per item `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch`, own port (41200–41214, 5 per runner group) and own file DB under `/tmp/qa3r2/‹group›/`, `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported. Installs, exports, upgrades, config edits and self-pinging legs on scratch app copies compiled under their own `OS_PORT` with a private `OS_HOME`; the tree's `installed-packages/` stayed absent and `git status` clean. Scaffold items: the 76 public packages packed from this tree into a local registry (all 61 `@objectstack/*` lockfile integrity hashes match the local tarballs). Scheduled-work legs with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`.
- Runner: one Claude Code cloud session (BR runner thread for qa#3), 3 runner subagents in parallel (effort high), Playwright chromium with form sign-in and server-side identity proof per persona; vitest `--maxWorkers=1` one package per invocation.
- Timestamps: setup 12:38–12:53Z; tests 12:53–14:06Z (P 12:53–13:40, Q 12:53–13:31, R 12:53–14:06). Setup : test ≈ 15 min : 73 min.

## FAIL row, reproduction rule and disposition

### platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal · rev 5 · FAIL (5/7) · same as round 1

- **acceptance[0] and acceptance[3] · fail · stale spec → open card #33860 (no new card).** Repro (scratch showcase copy, private `OS_HOME`): two `defineStack` packages `com.qa.addr-a` (ns `qa_a`) and `com.qa.addr-b` (ns `qa_b`), each declaring `connectors: [{ name: 'qa_conn', type: 'api', enabled: false }]`; `os package install` a then b → expected 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`; actual both install and the bare `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/qa_conn` answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. A cold boot of `composeStacks([d, c], { manifest: 'preserve' })` of the pair logs no "Bare-name conflict at boot" line. Cause: #33431 narrowed `connector` per namespace by design, leaving no one-holder type for the clause to drive. No change on that path in a557fa38..b914e724, so not a regression.

## PARTIAL rows

- `platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface` acceptance[4] · blocked(environment, item knownGaps[1]): no agent catalog on the open framework, AI-chat page unreachable; the off-page half held twice. Same as round 1.
- `integration-system.notification-preference-suppression` acceptance[3] (mandatory-topic half) · blocked(fixture, item knownGaps[1]): `mandatoryTopics` is a MessagingServicePlugin constructor option, empty on the showcase; plugin-unit pin 27 passed. The user-over-global half passed live. #33779 (preferences read in the emitting organization) landed in range; a stock single-org boot can observe only the single-org reading (parked below).

Round 1 PARTIALs closed this round: `records-forms.gantt-interactions` (acceptance[1] and the auto-schedule half of acceptance[2] driven live through a temporary `showcase.custom` overlay adding `dependenciesField`) and `records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore` (negative[1] with a `showcase_ops` contributor member: no Undo, restore 403; admin control got Undo).

No P0 item is in this slice. No FAIL is a regression, none is data loss, none touches a customer-waited card. No security finding, and no re-hit of a known advisory.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 36 minutes in total (P ~11, Q ~9, R ~16), on the items' own boots after their clauses had verdicts, as admin, contributor members (`showcase_ops` and plain), stock members and anonymous clients. Boundary classes: unknown request / package / flow ids, single values where lists are declared, unknown and duplicate users in a pick, reserved names (`_status`), empty / upper-case / malformed manifest namespaces. Opposite postures: enable beside disable, namespace-less beside namespaced, scheduled work on beside off. Readers outside scope: members on approval decisions, created records outside their read scope. Findings: card-R2-BR-1; a contributor who creates a task gets the "created" toast and then lands on "Record not found" (the showcase shows a contributor only tasks assigned to it and a new task has no assignee; write and feedback are correct, not filed, parked as a fixture/item candidate); one re-hit of #33865. Per-door detail is at the end of each clause file.

### group R

- records-forms.gantt-interactions · acceptance[1], acceptance[2] · knownGaps[0] fixture gap closed without touching the showcase source: a showcase.custom pair overlay of view `showcase_task.gantt` adding `dependenciesField: 'notes'` (task textarea; ObjectGantt `normalizeDependencies` accepts a CSV of predecessor ids) makes `autoSchedule` render (`ObjectGantt.tsx` `autoSchedule={!!ganttConfig?.dependenciesField}`), so both auto-schedule clauses are live-runnable on any stock boot. Suggest the item's steps[3]/knownGaps[0] carry this overlay recipe instead of "blocked(fixture) by design".
- records-forms.gantt-interactions · steps[0] · the view opens at Day scale on today, so the done bars (Nov 5–9, Oct 26–28) are off-screen; switch to Month (`gantt-view-mode-month`) before dragging.
- records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore · negative[1] · the "cannot show the absence" note is stale: `qa-fixture.mjs contributor-member --position showcase_ops` mints a member who may delete `showcase_project_membership` rows (OpsPermissionSet, examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts:240) without any restore grant, so the absence and the 403 restore door are both observable on a stock boot. Suggest naming that persona in fixtures/steps.
- records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore · steps[0] · the record page's Delete sits in the header's ⋯ "More actions" menu (Refresh, Add to favorites, Share, Delete), not as an inline button.
- records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore · observation · an object with no name field (showcase_project_membership) gets a confirm titled 'Delete Membership "Record #zJ0Un97fEVQElA_I"?' and a generic toast 'Membership deleted successfully' instead of the named 'X "…" deleted' — the raw id in the confirm is labels-over-machine-names territory; not scored here.
- records-forms.home-amount-preview-states · steps[2] · (confirmed from round 1) the contributor recipe's own invoice has no line and no currency, so amount is null and the preview never mounts; prep: admin POSTs one invoice line, the member PATCHes currency_code USD, then drive the form. Suggest adding this to fixtures.provisioning.
- records-forms.home-amount-preview-states · observation · on the member's form after Currency → EUR, the line grid's footer still reads "Subtotal $100.00 / Total $100.00" while "Total incl. Tax" reads €100.00 — the footer keeps the stored currency's symbol until save; display nuance, not scored.
- studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle · steps[0] · round 1's dataset-closure 409 is avoided by creating the writable package with `dependencies: { 'com.example.showcase': '^0' }` on POST /api/v1/packages; the widget then renders bars at runtime and in Studio. Suggest the step say so.
- studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle · steps[3] · the header chip 'Draft · N unpublished' is per item (it shows only while the selected item itself has a draft; N is the package count), so after the dashboard's own publish the chip goes while the pill keeps counting the app draft — reading "chip gone" as "package clean" is wrong.
- studio-authoring.flow-status-matches-runtime · steps[4] · the launch entry is reproducible as the canonical boot with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` exported on a fresh file DB (boot banner "20 bound" vs "18 bound" on the default boot); an `interval 60000` schedule flow authored over the API ran its first schedule-trigger run ≈62 s later.
- ux-conventions.write-feedback · steps[2] (Studio autosave) · with no records, the Studio object's Records grid shows no columns, so there is no field to rename; add one record first, then the column header's 'Edit field properties' (data-testid grid-edit-column-FIELD) opens the field inspector with the Label input. Clicking the header text itself sorts the column.
- ux-conventions.write-feedback · variants[6] · on this build, clicking EXP-2001 on the approvals page opens the expense report's record page (showcase_expense_report/record/…), where Approve sits in the header. The decision is taken there, not on a sys_approval_request_detail page.
- ux-conventions.write-feedback · steps[1] · the update-mode import's result screen shows 'Import Complete · 2 updated' with no toast (the create-mode run toasts 'Imported 2 rows.'). The inline result counts as feedback.
